errors.what: No intermittent motion: the wheel rotates continuously and uniformly through the whole driver revolution (wheel_deg goes 0, 352.5, 345, 337.5, 330, ... 277.5 in steady 7.5 deg steps per 30 deg of driver), instead of turning only during engagement (|phi|<=45 deg) and dwelling locked at 315 deg otherwise.

Drive pin is not engaged in a slot while it is away from the wheel and the wheel keeps turning; in frames the pin sits outside any slot, so pin/slot coupling is not kinematically consistent. Per-revolution wheel index is only 90 deg but is spread over the whole cycle, so wheel phase is wrong (should be 315 deg after phi=45 deg).
